title: Oracle return configuration
statement: Given a Boolean input list $x$, a tape-content function $f:\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$, integers $bookmark$ and $pos$, a dispatch state $q$, an input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions, and an output list, define a four-work-tape configuration as the corresponding local configuration at head position $pos$, with the second tape replaced by the fixed origin contents whose value at $bookmark$ is false.
caveat: The fixed origin contents are referenced in the definition but are not defined in the supplied payload.
